dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 with SORT, INDEXED file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, and inline END-READ/END-IF scope terminators. No vendor-specific extensions visible. Could be GnuCOBOL or similar open-source compiler given file-based assignments.

purpose.domain_detail: Employee reporting system generating group-wise employee lists by location for a company (Capgemini Global Solutions mentioned in heading)
purpose.summary: MODEMP sorts an employee input file by location code, then reads through employees and a location indexed file to produce a formatted report listing employees grouped by location and group. The report includes headings with company name, location, group, and detail lines with employee code, name, and designation.

notable_features: INDEXED file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY (LOC-CITY)
Multiple FILE STATUS fields with 88-level conditions
Commented-out LABEL RECORDS and BLOCK CONTAINS clauses
verdict.notes: The program has some structural issues suggesting a student exercise: PROCESS-PARA and READ-EMP-PARA call each other recursively which could cause stack overflow; multiple 88-level conditions named OPEN-SUCCESS on separate 01-level items; GROUP-CHANGE-PARA and LOC-CHANGE-PARA logic appears incomplete. The company name 'CAPGEMINI GLOBAL SOLUTIONS' in the heading suggests a training/exercise context. Two lines slightly exceed column 72 (long_lines_over_72=2).
